correctness.rationale: The endpoint-centering functional maps the joint Donsker limit to independent Brownian bridges. Positivity follows from a nonzero conditional Gaussian time covariance; non-unit distance correlation from the scaled-isometry equality case; full support from pinned triangular-wave test paths. Independence of the bridges reduces expected K to the squared expected centered-distance kernel. Its constant row integral is B(3/2,3/2)=pi/8, and its squared matrix integral is 1/6, yielding 1/(3pi)-pi/32. The finite Gaussian formula uses circular time-distance rows and exact (n^2-1)/(6n^2). The permutation bound uses the exact conditional permutation expectation and tightness of the ratio. The independent standard-library checker passed 6,155 finite assertions; these are supplementary rather than proofs of limits.
